The docs for AI agents (https://llmstxt.org): every page with its address and the
`description` from its front matter, in sidebar order, one section per top-level page.
Built from front matter on every build, like help.json. See README.md.
{%- endcomment -%}
# {{ site.title }} Docs

> Official documentation for Vote4Dance, a platform for running dance competitions: registration, check-in, judging, results and rankings. Written for organizers, dancers and parents, clubs, spectators, federation staff and scrutineers.

- Every link below is a page on {{ site.url }}, in English. There is one section for each kind of reader.
- The organizer's pages describe the classic Manager. Where the new Manager (shown in the app as Scrutineer, with a Beta tag) differs, the page says so.
- Questions about one competition, such as entries, prices and refunds, are answered by its organizer and not by Vote4Dance: see [Getting help]({{ site.url }}/getting-help/).
